scope: Twenty-five reserved mana crops were first measured and visually reviewed after the candidate commit. All printed costs match. Review does not certify title/body text or whole-frame registration. Beta is not covered.
gate: Each set has positive median F1 gains at both tiers and at least 90% of costs nonregressing within .02. All reserved crops reviewed. One table-tier exception is retained explicitly, not omitted from the numbers.

exception.name: Sol Ring
exception.evidence: The independent circular-edge detector supports the new x432/y46 position within half a design pixel. The enlarged table crop shows the printed narrow numeral and retained broader SVG with different disc contrast. Signed contrast improves .8085 to .8182; inspect F1 also improves. Exact cause of the table boundary-score loss is not isolated. Retain as an explicit small-size shape/measurement review, with no card-specific offset.

assetReview: Retained B.svg skull teeth/eye and jaw outlines differ visibly from both sets.
Retained G.svg canopy and root shapes differ; U.svg is rounder than the printed droplet.
R.svg flame contour and generic digit stroke weight differ. Sol Ring retains 1.svg as a named review example.
Cost disc hue/contrast differs from scans; these color differences are not calibration targets.
